parent_scope: N7.4 — Idempotencia e integraciones externas — Inspeccion dirigida + revision
acceptance: Confirmar estado real, alcance/fuera de alcance, componentes afectados, dependencias, riesgos, criterios de aceptacion, rollback y estrategia de pruebas para idempotencia e integraciones externas sin implementar cambios grandes en PRE.

facts: Application already requires, trims and tenant-binds Idempotency-Key before staging.
Database mapping already enforces unique EmpresaId + ClaveIdempotencia and unique EventoId.
Retry processor is tenant-bound and its dispatcher contract requires propagating ClaveIdempotencia to the provider.
End-to-end provider-side idempotency is not yet proven by a concrete provider adapter in the inspected exact-head integration surface.

in_scope: Formalize external-provider idempotency semantics and durable identity propagation.
Implement or prove a concrete provider adapter/dispatcher that forwards the durable key.
Verify retry/crash replay produces one external effect.
Audit tenant isolation and safe provider error handling.
Document operational recovery and rollback semantics.
out_of_scope: main, Produccion, deploy, secrets and PR #2.
New migration when existing persistence is sufficient and no causal model gap is proven.
Frontend work unless a later stage demonstrates a causal user-visible requirement.

risks: Provider effect can succeed before local delivery confirmation; a retry can dispatch again unless provider-side idempotency is honored.
Tenant identity or idempotency key must never be accepted from an untrusted cross-tenant source.
Provider errors must not leak payload, credentials or secret material into audit evidence.
Adding schema/UI without a demonstrated causal need would be filler and is prohibited.
rollback_strategy: N7.4.A changes no production behavior or schema. Evidence-only commits are functionally equivalent to the dependency head. Downstream implementation must use normal forward commits for rollback; no reset/force-push.
test_strategy: MODEL: same-key/same-intent and same-key/different-intent contract tests.
BACKEND_API: verify provider adapter forwards the durable idempotency key and preserves tenant scope.
SEC_AUDIT: verify allow-listed errors and no secret/payload leakage.
TEST_CI: simulate provider-success followed by local-confirmation failure, retry, concurrency and tenant isolation; assert a single external effect.

review_first.notes: The PRE microtask is complete: the implementation risk is explicitly identified and directed to N7.4.B-H. The downstream provider-idempotency gap is not an unresolved P1 of PRE itself, because PRE acceptance is inspection, scope and directed planning rather than implementation.
